WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(CENTROMEA, 'missing') AS status,
        CASE
            WHEN WBC IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN WBC > 6.5 THEN 'high'
            ELSE 'low'
        END AS wbc_band,
        GOT - GPT AS ast_minus_alt,
        APTT - PT AS aptt_minus_pt
    FROM Laboratory
),
per_status AS (
    SELECT
        status,
        wbc_band,
        AVG(ast_minus_alt) AS avg_ast_minus_alt,
        AVG(aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt
    FROM base
    GROUP BY status, wbc_band
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_ast_minus_alt) AS avg_of_ast_minus_alt,
    AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_of_aptt_minus_pt
FROM per_status;
